start: Member: Settings, Your gym, joined 'Iron Den', no open orders, online

steps.action: Tap 'Leave Iron Den' (sub line 'Your workouts stay on this phone. Your leaderboard numbers are removed from the gym.')
user_sees: A question 'Leave Iron Den?' with 'Your workouts stay on this phone. You can join again with the code.'
Buttons 'Leave gym' and 'Stay'
must_not: Leaving without the question

user_sees: The Your gym rows gone; the app in MettleUp's colours if the gym was branded
must_not: The member's workouts deleted
Gym reminders still arriving

start: Member: Settings, Your gym, the gym's leaderboard has loaded in this session

steps.action: Tap 'What my gym can see' (sub 'Your name on the leaderboard' or 'Your name shows on the leaderboard')
user_sees: The 'What my gym can see' page
must_not: The sub saying the name shows when the switch is off

start: Member: Settings, Your gym, one shop order ready at the desk

user_sees: The question says the order is ready and to collect it or ask the desk to cancel it
must_not: Leaving with a ready order and no word

steps.action: With an open order, tap the leave button while offline
user_sees: "Your order isn't cancelled yet" with 'Try again' and 'Not now'
must_not: The member left with the order still open

user_sees: Settings as before
must_not: The member left anyway

start: Member: Settings, Your gym, just left while offline

user_sees: The rows gone and a note that the gym is told when the phone is back online
must_not: The note missing
The member still joined on the gym's list for good

user_sees: The Your gym rows back with 'Leave <gym>'
must_not: Old reminders or the old membership plan coming back

start: Member: Settings, Your gym, name shown on the leaderboard, trainer summary on

steps.action: Leave the gym and ask the gym owner what they still see
user_sees: The gym's leaderboard, trainer summary, machine use, shared workouts and messages without this member
must_not: Leaderboard numbers kept
The mobile number kept on the gym's records against the promise
